name: When should plumbing and electrical coordination discussions start in a construction project?

mainEntity.name: When should plumbing and electrical coordination discussions start in a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Discussions and planning for plumbing and electrical coordination should begin early in the design phase of any construction or renovation project. Ideally, this happens when architectural plans are being developed and before any demolition or framing starts. Involving both the plumber and electrician, or a general contractor overseeing both, from the outset allows for integrated planning, identification of potential conflicts, and proactive solutions to avoid issues during the construction phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coordination discussions should start early in the design phase, before demolition or framing, for integrated planning.
